title: LSP basic structures
description: Basic structures of the Language Server Protocol 3.17, written as JSON Schema from the specification's meta model.

Position.description: Position in a text document expressed as zero-based line and zero-based character offset.

Range.description: A range in a text document expressed as (zero-based) start and end positions.

Location.description: Represents a location inside a resource, such as a line inside a text file.

TextDocumentIdentifier.description: A literal to identify a text document in the client.

TextDocumentItem.description: An item to transfer a text document from the client to the server.

MarkupContent.description: A string value whose kind tells the client how to render it.
